title: The sum-rule conjecture for two-boundary Temperley–Lieb ground states
statement:
Let $si$ be the ground-state vector, and let $S^{\mathrm{X}}_{N}(q,Q)$ denote the sum of all its components on the Kazhdan–Lusztig basis of boundary type $\mathrm{X}$, where $\mathrm{X}\in\{\mathrm{A},\mathrm{BI},\mathrm{BII},\mathrm{BIII}\}$. Let $A_n$ count symmetric binary matrices with no row sum greater than one, let $B_n$ count bisymmetric permutation matrices modulo rotation by $\pi/2$, and let $C_n$ be the signed-permutation sequence described in the source. **Sum-rule conjecture.** At $q=1$ and $Q=1$, 
$$
S^{\mathrm{A}}_{N}=A_N,\qquad S^{\mathrm{BI}}_{N}=B_{N+1}\quad\text{for }M=1,
$$
 
$$
S^{\mathrm{BI}}_{N}=C_{N+1}\quad\text{for }M=\infty,\qquad S^{\mathrm{BIII}}_{N}=C_{N+1}.
$$
 These identities conjecturally identify the total ground-state weights with the stated matrix enumerations; the paper gives recurrences and initial values for the sequences and notes the BI/BIII coincidence at $M=\infty$, but no resolution is supplied.
source_name: Keiichi Shigechi, “A Positive integral property on the ground state of the two-boundary Temperley–Lieb Hamiltonian”, arXiv:1412.7617 (2014).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1412.7617

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2014).
